name: Warawanai Erika
source:
Main character's beloved sister Erika dies of heart disease. He lost all the motivation, but his part-time job of private tutor gradually helps him recover. Can he find his other self?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角深爱的妹妹绘里香因心脏病去世。他失去了生活的全部动力，兼职做家庭教师却让他逐渐振作起来。他能否找到另一个自己？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
